## Description

Constructs dynamic cointegration networks where Graph Attention Networks (GATs) weigh pair relationships, selecting robust multi-asset cointegrated baskets for statistical arbitrage.

## Where it may fit

Statistical arbitrage pair and basket trading, structural equity sector rotation, relative value trading.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Hedge Funds, Quantitative Market-Neutral Equity Desks.

## Required data

Daily and intraday closing price series across equity universes, Augmented Dickey-Fuller p-values.

## Caveats

Graph attention weight stability requires regular re-estimation of cointegration vectors.
